Since 0<|h|<η=t0/4, a<b and [a,b] is positive and contained in the F002 time interval. H002 and D005 give continuity and the indicated derivative there; extension elsewhere has no effect. Its slope equals the desired quotient for either sign of h. For x∈Q the intermediate derivative is bounded by B0. M001 at S005 has A=ℝ^n with Lebesgue measure, G=ℝ, F=Fseq, f=e_t(·,t0), b=B0·1_Q. F004 supplies almost everywhere strong measurability, pointwise domination and pointwise convergence; F003 supplies integrability of b. These meet every premise in the supplied M signatures, and the conclusion is exactly convergence of the spatial integrals. The routine facts used to establish those premises have the actual conditions recorded below. There are no E applications.
